subject: Executive go/no-go window & closure logistics for MAP - final paperwork
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina@stellarmarketing.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lara Chen <l.chen@stellarmarketing.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft & timeline — exec signoff window

Hi Grace / Jonas,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Lara and I reviewed the MAP you shared and are aligned on scope — we just need to lock the executive go/no-go window and the timing for signature and kickoff.

Two constraints from our side:
- Our VP of Product is out Apr 6–8 (travel) but can do an approval call Apr 7 afternoon PT if necessary.
- Procurement needs a minimum 5 business-day review for the SOW and payment terms before a May 3 start date.

Can you confirm the exact dates Redwood needs for final signoff and whether the Master Subscription Agreement will be the baseline or if you expect our legal to redline an SOW-first approach?

Thanks,
Nina
Nina Patel
Head of Product Operations
Stellar Marketing
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Patel <nina@stellarmarketing.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Apr 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & timeline — exec signoff window

Hi Nina — appreciate the quick read.

Summary of what we need from Stellar to close on the MAP and commit to a May 3 start:
1) Executive go/no-go decision by end-of-day (EOD) Apr 7 PT so we can do a final pre-provisioning check Apr 8.
2) Signed Master Subscription Agreement (MSA) + countersigned SOW into DocuSign by Apr 12 to satisfy procurement lead time for a May 3 kickoff.
3) Confirmation of the kickoff workstream owner and primary contacts for integration (name + email) by Apr 6.

I attached the working MAP with a proposed approval gate cadence (Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf). Our standard approach is to baseline the MSA and attach an SOW; if Stellar wants to redline the SOW first that's fine — we can parallelize legal reviews to meet timelines but we'll need explicit signoff on the MSA to start provisioning.

I'll copy legal for a short review and Jonas will own procurement alignment.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP, approvals, milestone dates)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Patel <nina@stellarmarketing.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Apr 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement + signature logistics

Nina / Grace — Jonas here. Quick procurement notes so expectations are aligned:
- If Stellar counters the MSA, procurement will need the redline back by Apr 9 to keep the Apr 12 DocuSign target.
- We can accept a PO after countersignature if your finance team prefers that flow; invoice terms in the MSA default to Net 30 unless you propose otherwise.
- DocuSign process: we'll initiate the envelope once we get the final MSA (preferred) or final SOW (if you want to lock technical scope first). DocuSign invitations take 1–2 business days to circulate and complete.

I'll circulate an internal checklist for our onboarding team once we have a signed SOW to confirm provisioning lead times for the Dedicated capacity option.

-Jonas
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Lara Chen <l.chen@stellarmarketing.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@stellarmarketing.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@procureco.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement + signature logistics

Thanks Jonas — quick update from Legal/Procurement:
- We prefer to redline the SOW first and then align on a final MSA to avoid duplicate edits.
- Can you confirm if Redwood requires any SOC2 evidence for the Dedicated deployment before signoff? Our security team will need to see the latest report.
- Preferred kickoff: May 3 works if we can close by Apr 12.

Tom, looping you for PO timing.

—Lara
Senior Counsel, Stellar Marketing
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Chen <l.chen@stellarmarketing.com>, Nina Patel <nina@stellarmarketing.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP — final checklist, signoff owners, and signature timeline (ACTION: confirm by EOD Apr 7)

Lara / Nina — thanks. Per your request we've moved the SOW-first path into the MAP with parallel MSA review to keep the overall cadence. Below is the final checklist and where we need decisions by EOD Apr 7 PT: 

MAP final checklist (items for Stellar to provide):
- Dedicated SOW redline (track changes) — deliver by Apr 9 if you want us to meet Apr 12 DocuSign.
- Executive approval window booked: Apr 7, 3:00–3:30 PM PT (tentative) — please confirm attendees and whether it will be recorded.
- Primary integration lead: name + email (to be added to onboarding runbook) — due Apr 6.
- SOC2 report link / summary (or SOC2 in progress note) — due Apr 6.

Redwood actions (for transparency):
- We'll send the SOW template and a pre-filled MSA in DocuSign once we receive an initial redline from Stellar.
- Provisioning window reserved Apr 12–14 for environment prep (contingent on signed SOW + MSA).
- Proposed start date (kickoff): May 3, 2027. If signatures slip past Apr 12, we'll need to move kickoff out by at least two weeks.

Attachments: SOW-Stellar-2027-05.pdf (SOW template), Master-Subscription-Agreement-Redwood.docx
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8092/Deal-8812
DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc123-fake

ACTION REQUESTED (Stellar): Confirm the Apr 7 exec approval slot and provide the integration lead + SOC2 note by Apr 6. If we receive confirmation, Redwood will lock the Apr 12 DocuSign envelope and follow up with a final go/no-go checklist for execs.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
